summary: Submitted a lease-varied experiment to close the VerifyLeader account's unvaried-lease limitation. The harness builds the same five-member shape with two demoted non-voters and cuts the leader from the two remaining voters while both non-voters stay reachable, then repeats VerifyLeader every 50 ms until the first failure; it runs that at a 500 ms lease over a 600 ms election timeout and at a 1 s lease over a 1 s election timeout. Local verification shows the window following the lease: the 500 ms case verified successfully at 0 ms, produced ten consecutive successes and failed at about 509 ms, while the 1 s case proved the same shape, produced twenty successes and failed at about 1020 ms, with the leader ending as a follower in both. A 2 s setting was attempted and abandoned during construction because the cluster helper's stability wait is shorter than the election timeout such a lease implies; the submission records that as an exclusion. Both case events are emitted before the verification loop and are declared as prerequisites keyed on case, lease and reachability, and each result event asserts that the first verification must fail with only one of three voters reachable, so the two settings can be compared directly.
